scientific_role: fresh real-system validation candidate for calibration-only selective Layer-B promotion

source_identity.title: Repository of camera trap data recorded during three pilot studies of the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen
source_identity.public_description_basis: Three Camtrap DP pilot packages; two inside herbivore exclosures, third outside exclosures; Dama dama reported as most prevalent in the third pilot.

selection_boundary.focal_taxon_selection_basis: public Zenodo description states European fallow deer was most prevalent in the third pilot conducted outside exclosures
selection_boundary.target_pilot_rule: select the unique Camtrap DP package whose package/project metadata identifies the outside-exclosure pilot; do not use observation counts or observation rows for pilot selection

prospective_context_rule.split_algorithm: after eligible weekly contexts are enumerated from deployments only, order unique ISO weeks chronologically; earliest 60% inner_train, next 20% inner_validation, final 20% untouched_outer; floor boundaries are computed deterministically and frozen before observations access

selective_promotion_rule.promotion: promote Layer B only if frozen inner-validation macro binary log loss is strictly lower than baseline-only; otherwise retain baseline-only
selective_promotion_rule.selected_arm_refit_policy: after inner selection, refit selected arm on inner_train plus inner_validation using the same frozen learner and score untouched outer once

if_stop: terminal pre-response STOP; no transport, pilot, focal-taxon or split rescue within this attempt
